title: Mongo-backed NOEMA full file index
epistemic_status: implementation_card; local Mongo-compatible indexer with JSONL fallback

meaning.summary: Every eligible system file must have a stable metadata document before semantic search, Doctor targeting, or scalar-grid inference depends on it.
meaning.boundary: MongoDB is an optional sink. If no live Mongo server is available, the canonical emission for the iteration is JSONL plus SHA256; no live DB write is claimed.
meaning.why: Previous NOEMA surface searched selected manifest/card/seed-index layers but did not materialize a full per-file Mongo catalog. That made blind spots possible when files existed outside cards or hand-built registries.

index_policy.metadata_only_for: binary, archive, database, very large, or unknown files
index_policy.semantic_chunks: deferred layer; do not confuse full file catalog with semantic content ingestion

description: Mongo-backed NOEMA full file index — katalog plików z metadanymi i SHA256
